Deze opdracht is een rebranding voor Jaz: This assignment is a rebranding for Jazz in 't Park, a Ghent Jazz festival. I went for a playful and cheerful brand because Jazz in 't Park is a joyful festival in early September in the Voorhaven park in Ghent. Below you will find my basic set and some applications such as posters, Instagram posts, program booklets...
Voor deze opdracht heb ik een aangelever: For this assignment, I designed a supplied poem into a poster. The focus here was on typography, composition and visually reinforcing the mood and meaning of the poem. I chose a contrasting style to powerfully convey the message.
Voor deze opdracht heb ik zelfstandig ee: For this assignment, I independently developed a village newspaper. I was responsible for gathering information, conducting interviews, writing articles and designing the layout. The goal was to inform residents and strengthen the village feeling. This final assignment taught me how to independently execute a project, create content and design a product from start to finish.
